source.title: Made-to-order spiking neuron model equipped with a multi-timescale adaptive threshold

specialization.numerical_contract: forward Euler membrane at 0.001 ms plus exact exponential threshold-history decay
specialization.event_contract: sampled level detection after decay; voltage is not reset

stimulus.current_na: 32 zeros, 8192 samples at 0.7, then 1024 repetitions of [0.2, 0.9]

oracle.implementation: independent direct transcription of source equations; does not import production kernels
oracle.canonical_row_format: little-endian float64 (v, theta, refractory_remaining_ms) plus uint8 event
